column1: # Credential redaction vectors (SP-0029 SHELL-01): redactCredentialArgs in cmd/filedo/fdsec_redact.go
# and Runner.RedactCredentialArgs in filedo_win_vb (the run report's Command line) are both held to
# this file - TestShell_ReportRedactionMatchesTheCLI reads it, and filedo_win.exe --selftest reads the
# copy embedded in the exe. One vector per line: the input tokens, a lone "=>", the expected tokens,
# every token separated by a tab. A line starting with # is a comment.
# The disk-container family (SP-0004 P5 T5.3): both forms, every credential source, mount's bare trailing token.
# SP-0004 P6: the new verbs, both forms, every credential form; export's destination and grow's size are kept by what their parsers take them for.
# A vd verb that takes no subject keeps no word after it as one (P6).
# vd status json, the snapshot of SP-0063 8.1: json is kept after status and nowhere else.
